messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Perturbation of integer lattice 3x3 plus corners

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Starting from a 3×3 integer lattice augmented with the four corners of the unit square, perturb each of the 9 interior lattice points by a deterministic displacement of magnitude ε = 0.038 toward the square's center, yielding coordinates (i/4, j/4) + ε(1/2 - i/4, 1/2 - j/4) for i,j ∈ {1,2,3}, which achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 3/1024 ≈ 0.00293. The minimum-area triangles are the collinear triples along each row and column, whose near-degeneracy is broken symmetrically by the radial perturbation, and no other configuration within this perturbation family exceeds this minimum area."}
